info.name: Ayar Souq - Admin APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive Admin API collection for Ayar Souq backend project. Includes all admin endpoints with authentication, validation, and examples.

## Authentication
All admin endpoints require:
1. **JWT Token** in Authorization header
2. **Admin Role** verification

## Base URL
`{{baseUrl}}/AyarSouqAPIs/api`

## Image Upload (R2 Cloudflare)
Category images use presigned R2 upload URLs via `POST /media/upload-url` with `type: category`. The flow is:
1. Get presigned URL + storageKey
2. PUT file to the presigned URL
3. Use storageKey as `image_storage_key` in create/update

## Collections Included
- **Admin Authentication** - Signin, password reset & change password
- **Categories Management** - CRUD operations with R2 presigned image upload
- **Ad Attributes Management** - Attribute definitions, options, and category-attribute mappings (CRUD + reorder)
- **Posts/Ads Management** - List, get details, approve, reject, update & delete posts with price types (fixed/market/contact), seller info & verification badges
- **Users Management** - User administration
- **Identity Verification (KYC)** - Manual review of user identity documents (Emirates ID + selfie)
- **Business Verification** - Business request review workflow (list, approve, reject, requestMoreInfo, revoke, checkLicense) + public profile view/edit
- **Metals Pricing** - Metal prices management & daily notifications
- **Notifications Management** - Send, list & delete multi-language notifications

request.description:
Get a presigned R2 upload URL for a category image.

**2-step upload flow:**
1. Call this endpoint to get `storageKey` + `uploadUrl`
2. PUT the image file directly to `uploadUrl` (with the same `Content-Type` header)
3. Use the returned `storageKey` as `image_storage_key` in Create/Update Category

**Parameters:**
- **type** (required): `category` (admin-only), `ad`, `profile`, `business_logo`, `business_cover`
- **contentType** (required): `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, or `image/gif`
- **fileSize** (required): file size in bytes (max 5MB = 5242880)

**Note:** Only admins can upload `category` type images. The presigned URL expires shortly after issuance.

Create new category with English and Arabic names.

**image_storage_key**: Use the `storageKey` returned by 'Get Category Image Upload URL' after uploading the file to R2. Pass `null` or omit to create a category without an image.

Update existing category. All fields except categoryId are optional.

**image_storage_key**: Use the `storageKey` from 'Get Category Image Upload URL'. The old R2 image is automatically deleted when replaced.
Delete category by ID. This will permanently remove the category.

item.name: 👥 Users Management

request.description:
Get paginated list of all users with filtering options.

**Filters:**
- `status`: `active` | `inactive` | `all` (default: `all`)
- `verified`: `true` | `false` (phone verification)
- `searchTerm`: search by name or email
- `accountType`: `individual` | `business` | `all` (default: `all`) — `individual` includes users with NULL account_type (pre-migration)
- `identityStatus`: `unverified` | `verified` | `expired` | `revoked` | `all` (default: `all`)

**Response includes:**
- `account_type`, `identity_status`, `identity_expires_on`
- `isIdentityVerified` (computed: identity verified AND not expired)
- `isBusinessVerified` (computed: business account + verified profile + valid license)
- `sellerType`: `individual` | `business`
- `tradeName`: business trade name (null for individuals)
- `businessProfileStatus`: business profile status (null for individuals)
- `profile_image_storage_key`

item.name: 🪪 Identity Verification (KYC)

exec: pm.test('Response has requests and pagination', function () {

request.description:
Get paginated list of identity verification requests.

**status** (optional): `draft` | `pending` | `more_info_required` | `approved` | `rejected` | `cancelled` | `all` (default)
**userId** (optional): filter by user ID

Stores the first request ID as `kycRequestId` for the other requests.

exec: pm.test('Response has request, viewUrls and events', function () {

request.description:
Get full details of a verification request including:
- **viewUrls**: short-lived signed URLs (120s) for front/back/selfie documents — open them immediately
- **possibleDuplicate**: true if the user-entered ID number hash matches another account's claim
- **events**: audit trail (submitted, resubmitted, more_info_requested, approved, rejected, ...)

⚠️ The reviewer MUST verify the ID number on the document image matches the entered data before approving.

Approve a **pending** request.

- **idNumberFromDocument** (required): the 15-digit Emirates ID number AS READ FROM THE DOCUMENT IMAGE by the reviewer. Dashes/spaces and Arabic digits are normalized server-side. This is the value used for duplicate prevention — not the user's input.
- **idExpiryDateFromDocument** (required): expiry date read from the document (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be in the future (Asia/Dubai) or the request fails with `ID_EXPIRED`.
- **internalNote** (optional): never shown to the user.

Fails with `IDENTITY_ALREADY_CLAIMED` (409) if this ID is already verified for another account.
On success: user gets `verified` status + badge, expiry date, and a push notification.

body.raw:
{
    "requestId": {{kycRequestId}},
    "reasonCode": "id_front_unreadable",
    "userMessage": "صورة الهوية الأمامية غير واضحة، يرجى إعادة التصوير بإضاءة جيدة",
    "missingItems": ["id_front"],
    "internalNote": "Glare on the front side hologram"
}

request.description:
Ask the user to re-capture documents. Only works on **pending** requests.

- **reasonCode** (required): one of `id_front_unreadable`, `id_back_unreadable`, `selfie_mismatch`, `selfie_unreadable`, `id_expired`, `id_not_uae`, `name_mismatch`, `photo_mismatch`, `document_tampered`, `policy_violation`, `other`
- **userMessage** (optional): shown to the user in the app
- **missingItems** (optional): subset of `["id_front", "id_back", "selfie"]`
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only, never shown to the user

The user will need to re-capture all 3 documents and resubmit.

Reject a **pending** request with a clear reason.

- **reasonCode** (required): same list as requestMoreInfo
- **userMessage** (optional): shown to the user — write a clear, respectful message
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only

The user can submit a brand new request afterwards. The rejection is logged in the events audit trail.

Revoke identity verification from a **verified** or **expired** account.

- **userId** (required): the user whose verification is revoked
- **reasonCode** (required): same list as reject
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only

⚠️ The identity claim is KEPT — the same Emirates ID cannot be used by another account after revocation (fraud protection). Releasing the claim is a manual DB operation, not exposed via API.
The user cannot self-serve a new request after revocation (gets `IDENTITY_REVOKED_CONTACT_SUPPORT`).

item.description:
Manual review of identity verification (KYC) requests.

**Workflow:** user captures Emirates ID (front+back) + live selfie → request becomes `pending` → admin reviews documents via short-lived signed URLs → approve / requestMoreInfo / reject.

**Request states:** `draft` → `pending` → `approved` | `rejected` | `more_info_required` (→ resubmit → `pending`). `cancelled` by user or system.

**Account identity status** (on the user record): `unverified` | `verified` | `expired` | `revoked`.

**Duplicate protection:** the reviewer-confirmed ID number is hashed (HMAC-SHA256) and claimed atomically at approve time — the same Emirates ID can never be verified for two accounts.

**Security:** documents live in private R2 storage under `kyc/` prefix; signed view URLs expire in 120 seconds; ID numbers are never stored in plain text (hash + last 4 digits only).

request.description:
Get paginated list of business verification requests.

**status** (optional): `draft` | `pending` | `more_info_required` | `approved` | `rejected` | `cancelled` | `all` (default)
**userId** (optional): filter by user ID

exec: pm.test('Response has request, viewUrls and events', function () {

request.description:
Get full details of a business verification request including:
- **viewUrls**: short-lived signed URLs (120s) for the license / authorization documents — open them immediately
- **events**: audit trail (submitted, resubmitted, more_info_requested, approved, rejected, ...)

⚠️ The reviewer MUST verify the license number, legal name, authority and expiry date ON THE DOCUMENT match the entered data before approving. Use **Check License Availability** first to make sure the license is not already claimed by another account.

Check whether a business license (authority + license number) is already claimed by a verified business account.

- **authorityCode** (required): `DED_DUBAI` | `ADDED` | `SEDD_SHARJAH` | `DED_AJMAN` | `DED_UAQ` | `DED_RAK` | `DED_FUJAIRAH` | `DMCC` | `JAFZA` | `RAKEZ` | `OTHER_FREEZONE`
- **authorityName** (required only when authorityCode = `OTHER_FREEZONE`)
- **licenseNumber** (required): as read from the document — normalized server-side (Arabic digits, dashes, case)

Returns `claimed: true/false`. Call this before approving to preview the duplicate check; the approve call re-checks atomically.

body.raw:
{
    "requestId": {{businessRequestId}},
    "legalNameFromDocument": "Golden Jewellery LLC",
    "licenseNumberFromDocument": "1234567",
    "authorityCodeFromDocument": "DED_DUBAI",
    "authorityNameFromDocument": null,
    "licenseExpiryDateFromDocument": "2027-12-31",
    "tradeNameConfirmed": "Golden Jewellery",
    "businessKindConfirmed": "store",
    "activityTypeConfirmed": "jewelry_store",
    "emirateStateIdConfirmed": 2,
    "internalNote": "License verified against DED registry"
}

request.description:
Approve a **pending** business request.

**From-document fields** (required, read from the license image by the reviewer — NOT the user's input):
- **legalNameFromDocument**
- **licenseNumberFromDocument** — normalized server-side; used for duplicate prevention
- **authorityCodeFromDocument** (+ **authorityNameFromDocument** when `OTHER_FREEZONE`)
- **licenseExpiryDateFromDocument** (YYYY-MM-DD) — must be in the future (Asia/Dubai) or fails with `LICENSE_EXPIRED`

**Confirmed public fields** (required — the reviewer confirms what appears publicly):
- **tradeNameConfirmed**, **businessKindConfirmed** (`store`|`company`), **activityTypeConfirmed** (`jewelry_store`|`bullion_trading`|`supplier`|`workshop`|`other`), **emirateStateIdConfirmed**

- **internalNote** (optional): never shown to the user.

Fails with `BUSINESS_LICENSE_ALREADY_CLAIMED` (409) if this license is already verified for another account.
On success: user `account_type` becomes `business`, profile becomes `verified` with the license expiry date, suspended ads are restored (renewal), and the user gets a push notification.

body.raw:
{
    "requestId": {{businessRequestId}},
    "reasonCode": "license_unreadable",
    "userMessage": "صورة الرخصة التجارية غير واضحة، يرجى إعادة الرفع بجودة أعلى",
    "missingItems": ["license"],
    "internalNote": "License number not legible in the scan"
}

request.description:
Ask the user to correct/re-upload documents. Only works on **pending** requests.

- **reasonCode** (required): one of `license_unreadable`, `license_expired`, `license_mismatch`, `authority_mismatch`, `name_mismatch`, `authorization_missing`, `authorization_unreadable`, `not_authorized_person`, `document_tampered`, `policy_violation`, `other`
- **userMessage** (optional): shown to the user in the app
- **missingItems** (optional): subset of `["license", "authorization", "legal_name", "trade_name", "address"]`
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only, never shown to the user

The user corrects the flagged items and resubmits.

Reject a **pending** business request with a clear reason.

- **reasonCode** (required): same list as requestMoreInfo
- **userMessage** (optional): shown to the user — write a clear, respectful message
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only

The user can submit a brand new application afterwards. The rejection is logged in the events audit trail.

Revoke business verification from a **verified** or **expired** business account.

- **userId** (required): the user whose business verification is revoked
- **reasonCode** (required): same list as reject
- **internalNote** (optional): admin-only

⚠️ The license claim is KEPT — the same license cannot be verified for another account after revocation (fraud protection).

request.description:
View any user's business public profile. Shows trade name, legal name, license info, contact details, social links, working hours, logo/cover URLs, and raw storage keys.

**Response:**
- `userId`, `profileStatus` (verified/expired/revoked/unverified)
- `tradeName`, `legalName`, `licenseNumberLast4`, `licenseExpiresOn`
- `businessKind`, `activityType`, `authorityName`
- `description`, `addressLine`, `contactPhone`, `contactEmail`, `websiteUrl`
- `socialLinks`, `workingHours`
- `logoUrl`, `coverUrl`, `logoStorageKey`, `coverStorageKey`

**Errors:** `NOT_A_BUSINESS_PROFILE` if user has no business profile or is not a business account

Edit a business user's public profile. Admin can update all fields including tradeName (admin-only).

**Admin-only field:** `tradeName` — not editable by the user, only by admin.

**All fields are optional** — only send fields you want to change:
- `userId` (required): Target business user ID
- `tradeName`: Business display name (admin-only)
- `description`: Business description (max 2000 chars)
- `contactPhone`: Public contact phone
- `contactEmail`: Public contact email
- `addressLine`: Business address
- `websiteUrl`: Business website URL
- `socialLinks`: Array of `{ platform, url }` objects
- `workingHours`: Array of `{ day, open, close, closed }` objects
- `logoStorageKey`: R2 storage key for logo (set to null to clear)
- `coverStorageKey`: R2 storage key for cover (set to null to clear)

**Note:** Admin skips storage key ownership validation — any valid storage key is accepted.

item.description:
Manual review of business verification requests.

**Workflow:** user submits trade license (+ authorization letter if applicable) → request becomes `pending` → admin reviews documents via short-lived signed URLs → checkLicense → approve / requestMoreInfo / reject.

**Request states:** `draft` → `pending` → `approved` | `rejected` | `more_info_required` (→ resubmit → `pending`). `cancelled` by user or system (72h stale drafts).

**Business status** (on the business profile): `unverified` | `verified` | `expired` | `revoked` — independent from identity expiry.

**Duplicate protection:** the reviewer-confirmed license number is normalized, hashed (HMAC-SHA256) and claimed atomically per issuing authority at approve time — the same license can never be verified for two accounts.

**Security:** documents live in private R2 storage under `business/docs/` prefix; signed view URLs expire in 120 seconds; license numbers are never stored in plain text (hash + last 4 digits only).

**Lifecycle cron jobs:** stale draft cleanup (72h), license expiry processing (daily, Dubai timezone), document deletion (90 days after terminal state), pending-deletion-key sweep.

**Public Profile Management:**
- `POST /getPublicProfile` — View any user's business public profile
- `POST /updatePublicProfile` — Edit business public profile (tradeName is admin-only)
